description: This file is an Angular application configuration file that sets up providers for zone change detection, routing, hydration, and HTTP client services.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Configures zone change detection with event coalescing enabled.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing with specified routes.

methods.name: provideHttpClient
methods.description: Provides HTTP client services for dependency injection.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Enables client hydration with event replay for server-side rendering support.
